text: A particle is projected with speed 20 m s at an angle of 60Å above the horizontal. Calculate the time
after projection when the particle is descending at an angle of 40Å below the horizontal. [4]

point B which is 0.6 m from P and on the same horizontal level as P. Equilibrium is maintained by a
horizontal force of magnitude 7 N applied to P (see Fig. 1).
